observation.visible_scene: A stage performance featuring a central female dancer in a white strappy outfit, flanked by two male dancers holding fire fans. The background is a large screen displaying abstract, colorful mountain or cloud imagery. The male dancers are shirtless with harness straps and white pants.
visible_changes: The woman initially faces right, pulling a thin string or wire connected to the male dancer on the right.
A large burst of flame erupts from the right dancer's fire fan as the woman maintains her pulling pose.
The woman turns her body to face left, shifting her stance and grip.
She then pulls a string connected to the male dancer on the left.
A large burst of flame erupts from the left dancer's fire fan near the end of the clip.
The camera gradually zooms in or tightens its framing on the central dancer throughout the sequence.
outside_clip_unknowns: The start of the musical performance or the choreography leading up to the first pull.
The outcome after the second fire burst on the left.
The specific mechanism connecting the strings to the fire props (e.g., whether they are physical triggers or part of the choreography).
uncertain_details: Whether the woman is pulling a single long string across the stage or switching between two separate strings connected to each dancer.
The exact timing of the fire bursts relative to the pulling motion (whether the pull causes the fire or they are synchronized cues).
